fields.label: Rate Window
fields.description: A blank field uses its default.

fields.label: Window (Seconds)
fields.description: Both call limits count calls over this many seconds. A refused caller is told to retry after this long.

fields.label: Calls Per Person
fields.description: Most calls one person's assistant may make in each window. Set 0 to remove this limit for each person.

fields.label: Calls For Everyone
fields.description: Most calls all assistants together may make in each window. Set 0 to remove the limit for the whole site.

fields.label: Search Results
fields.description: A blank or 0 uses the default.

fields.label: Handbook Results
fields.description: Most handbook pages one search returns. Each result has a title, a route and a short piece of the text.

fields.label: Schema Results
fields.description: Most doctypes, and most fields, that one schema search returns. A blank or 0 uses the default of 15.

fields.label: Characters Per Page
fields.description: Most characters of a long handbook page sent at once. The assistant asks for the next page by number.
